name: Consumo anual Paraguay
definition: Suma/valor anual oficial de energia SIN.

name: Demanda maxima Paraguay
definition: Maximo de potencia del periodo.

name: Dependencia Itaipu
definition: Energia Itaipu->PY / energia total abastecida PY * 100.

name: Dependencia Yacyreta
definition: Energia Yacyreta->PY / energia total abastecida PY * 100.

name: Participacion Acaray
definition: Energia Acaray->PY / energia total abastecida PY * 100.

name: Perdidas de transmision / energia SIN
definition: Perdidas transmision / energia SIN * 100.
class: Derived; no equivale a perdidas totales ANDE

name: Intensidad exportadora ANDE
definition: Exportacion ANDE / energia bruta disponible * 100.

name: Valor unitario cesion
definition: Compensacion efectiva / volumen cedido.
class: Mantener separado de precio de venta

name: Utilizacion estructural PY
definition: Demanda anual / referencia de energia estructural disponible * 100.

name: Horizonte 100% energia
definition: Año en que demanda proyectada alcanza energia estructural disponible.

name: Normal EnergiaPY para la hora
definition: Mediana/promedio por hora, dia semana y mes sobre historico horario.

name: Brecha cesion vs mercado
definition: Referencia mercado - compensacion unitaria de cesion.

name: Tarifa media residencial ANDE
definition: Precio medio anual efectivamente abonado por clientes residenciales, según ANDE.

name: Tarifa media nacional ANDE
definition: Precio medio anual del mercado nacional.

name: Relación tarifa residencial / exportación ANDE
definition: Tarifa media residencial / tarifa media de exportación ANDE del mismo periodo * 100.
class: Derived; no comparar con cesión binacional

name: Tarifa residencial real
definition: Tarifa media residencial deflactada por IPC BCP a año base definido.

name: Tarifa residencial equivalente
definition: Tarifa residencial Gs/kWh convertida con tipo de cambio BCP consistente del periodo.

name: Tipo de cambio USD/PYG
definition: Promedio anual para historicos; snapshot BCP para calculadoras actuales.

name: Inflacion IPC
definition: Variacion porcentual del IPC.

name: Tarifa ANDE real 2025
definition: Tarifa nominal * IPC_2025 / IPC_periodo.

name: Tarifa ANDE equivalente USD/MWh
definition: Tarifa nominal Gs/kWh * 1000 / FX promedio anual.

name: Asequibilidad electrica
definition: Tarifa residencial respecto a ingreso/PIB per capita o salario, cuando esas series esten incorporadas.

name: Residential billed use per customer
definition: Residential billed kWh / residential customers / 12.

name: Energy share by customer category
definition: Category billed kWh / national billed subtotal.

name: Special intensive consumer energy share
definition: GCIE billed kWh / national billed subtotal.

name: Electricity affordability proxy
definition: Estimated representative electricity bill / household income; clearly label assumptions.

name: Hydro-energy context
definition: Hydrology/reservoir/flow features linked to generation; model definition pending historical backfill.

name: ENSO state/probability
definition: NOAA CPC RONI probability and strength context.

name: Demand macro context
definition: IMAEP and sector growth used as exogenous demand features.

name: DEP quality indicator
definition: Equivalent interruption duration weighted by affected power.

name: FEP quality indicator
definition: Equivalent interruption frequency weighted by affected power.

name: Distribution loss rate
definition: ANDE distribution losses.

name: Air conditioner penetration
definition: Dwellings with AC / occupied dwellings.
